entities.summary: Ein Karem also Ein Kerem or Ain Karem, is a former Palestinian village southwest of Jerusalem, presently a neighborhood in the outskirts of the modern city, within the Jerusalem District in Israel. It is the site of the Hadassah Medical Center.
